captures.description: THE STANDARD, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI) is an ISO-certified global standard number (ISO 27729) used to uniquely identify the public identities of contributors to creative and scholarly works—including writers, researchers, artists, performers, publishers, and organizations.' What ISNI Does ('Resolves Name Ambiguity'; 'Connects Identities: Links multiple names, stage names, pseudonyms, or legal names used by a single person under one persistent digital profile'; a bridge to ORCID, IPI and ISBN); Key Details (format, size, governance); the home page and the Bowker register. Five cards: ISNI, Wikipedia, Bowker ISNI, BISG, a BISG video.

atoms.evidence: The International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI) is an ISO-certified global standard number (ISO 27729)
Governance: Managed by the London-based ISNI International Agency (ISNI-IA).
is an ISO-certified global standard number (ISO 27729) used to uniquely identify the public identities of contributors to creative and scholarly works
Database Size: Holds public records for over 16.6 million identities (including over 14.6 million individuals and 2 million organizations).
Resolves Name Ambiguity: Distinguishes creators and organizations who share identical or similar names across the global supply chain.
Format: A 16-digit identifier (15 numeric digits plus a MOD 11-2 check character).
